result.text: 6.0% of the area changed between 2023-01-01 and 2023-07-01 (88.0 ha). Dominant transitions: vegetation -> unclassified (3.0%, north); vegetation -> built-up / man-made surface (0.7%, north-east); water -> unclassified (0.7%, north-west). Change clusters: north-east (41.5 ha); north-west (37.4 ha); south (1.0 ha). Caveats: Relative radiometric normalisation applied to the later acquisition (band0: gain 0.977, offset -33.912; band1: gain 0.983, offset -47.838; band2: gain 0.988, offset -54.625; band3: gain 0.995, offset -90.698, ...). Change Vector Analysis over NDVI, NDWI, MNDWI, NDBI, BRIGHTNESS; threshold 0.7770 (Otsu 0.6963, separability 0.69, noise floor 0.7770)
